findings.finding: Nothing can trace the six FY2026 guidance items. Each cites only dc_call_q2, an Alpha Vantage transcript (provider_normalized, not independent), and its payload was not saved (no transcript file in companies/NBIS/raw/ or gather/raw_documents/). The saved issuer documents have no guidance: the OFR (ex99d1), the financial statements (ex99d2) and the 2026-08-12 press release (accession 0001104659-26-094568 ex99-1, fetched to check). The numbers lane says the May and Aug 2026 shareholder letters give revenue 3.0-3.4B, ARR 7-9B, about 40% adj EBITDA margin, 800MW-1GW connected and 5 GW contracted power, but 'no capex guidance in the letters read'. So dc_g_capex (20-25B) rests on the call alone. The 'group' scope of the 40% margin is also unverified.
findings.where: gather/documents.json guidance dc_g_arr, dc_g_rev, dc_g_margin, dc_g_capex, dc_g_mw, dc_g_cpower (source dc_call_q2)
findings.fix: Save the transcript payload verbatim. Register the Aug 2026 shareholder letter (IR site) as an issuer primary_document and cite it for dc_g_arr/rev/margin/mw/cpower. Confirm the margin's scope (group vs core AI cloud) from that letter. Keep dc_g_capex marked as call-only in notes, or drop it if the call text cannot be saved.

findings.finding: The Alpha Vantage sources are dated with the retrieval date 2026-11-01, so they are not citable until 2026-11-03 (ticker-trace lists them in sources_not_yet_citable). Facts that cite only AV therefore have no citable source at as_of: nm_revenue_fy2025q3, nm_revenue_fy2025q2, nm_operating_income_fy2026q2/q1, nm_net_income_fy2026q1, nm_cfo_fy2026q2/q1, nm_sbc_fy2026q2, nm_cash_fy2026q2, nm_total_debt_fy2026q2, nm_equity_fy2026q2 and nm_shares_outstanding_fy2026q2. The values that were checked match the 6-K: Q2 operating loss -175.9 and H1 -303.9, so Q1 is -128.0; Q2 CFO 2,246.1 and H1 4,504.1; Q2 SBC 102.5; cash 8,042.1; Q1 net income 621.2 (H1 continuing 430.8 minus Q2 -190.4).
findings.where: gather/numbers.json facts listed; sources nm_av_income, nm_av_balance, nm_av_cashflow
findings.fix: Add dc_6k_q2_ofr / dc_6k_q2_fs (dated 2026-08-12, citable) to the source_ids of the Q1/Q2 2026 facts. Add pf_cf_20260430 / companyfacts for the 2025 quarters. Do not redate the AV sources.

findings.finding: nm_total_debt_fy2026q2 (metric long_term_debt, 10,056.1M) is AV shortLongTermDebtTotal. It adds current debt 46.7 + non-current debt 8,499.0 + non-current operating lease liabilities 1,510.4 (AV calls these capitalLeaseObligations; ex99d2 balance sheet). Financial debt is 8,545.7M. Read as debt, this fact double-counts with dc_f_debt and treats operating leases as borrowings.
findings.where: gather/numbers.json facts nm_total_debt_fy2026q2; also note 'nm ROIC CHECK' and 'nm PRICE' (EV about 45.7B)
findings.fix: Change it to financial debt 8,545.7M (current 46.7 + non-current 8,499.0), citing dc_6k_q2_fs. Carry the operating lease liabilities as a separate item (1,510.4 non-current plus the current portion). Recompute the EV note. Add the post-balance-sheet financing to the capital bridge: the $4.5B convertible notes (dc_6k_conv, 2026-08-19) and the Citi $3.5B facility (dc_6k_citi, 2026-10-22).

findings.finding: nm_shares_outstanding_fy2026q2 (280,381,615, metric shares_diluted_wavg) comes from AV commonStockSharesOutstanding. It is actually the Q2 2026 weighted average, basic = diluted (ex99d2 line 826). Point-in-time shares outstanding at 2026-06-30 are Class A 238,400,165 + Class B 33,455,053 = 271,855,218 (dc_f_sh_a, dc_f_sh_b). The market cap note (43.7B on 280.4M shares) uses the weighted count for ownership.
findings.fix: Cite dc_6k_q2_fs and keep the fact as the weighted average for EPS only. Use 271,855,218 plus dilution after June 30 (ATM issuance, convertible notes, RSUs) for ownership, market cap and per-share value.

findings.finding: pf_net_income_fy2025 (82.5M) is total net income including discontinued operations of 72.7M. Net income from continuing operations for FY2025 is 9.8M (20-F income statement, reading/10k_full.txt around line 4760). The numbers lane's reconciliation note has this backwards: it says AV's 101.7M 'includes discontinued ops' and treats 82.5M as the comparable figure. The positive FY2025 EPS is then partly a discontinued-operations effect.
findings.where: gather/_prefetch.json fact pf_net_income_fy2025; gather/numbers.json notes 'nm RECONCILIATION FY2025' and 'nm OWN MULTIPLE HISTORY'
findings.fix: Use 9.8M (continuing operations) for FY2025 net income in the forecast base and the forensics. Label 82.5M as total including discontinued 72.7M, and correct the note.

findings.finding: The guidance track record cannot be checked. Its one row (FY2025 year-end ARR, guided mid 1.0B, actual 1.25B) cites only nm_rel_q4_2025, the reporting release, retrieved as search_excerpt. The release that issued the 0.9-1.1B guide is not cited. ticker-check returns track_record null, while the lane's note states a ratio of 1.25 with 1 beat. The two do not agree.
findings.fix: Add the guiding release (the Q3 2025 shareholder letter, Nov 2025) as a source with its date, plus whatever fields ticker-check needs to compute the ratio. Otherwise present the track record as not computable (n=0), not as 1 beat.

findings.finding: nm_rel_q2_2026 is titled 'press release (Ex.99.1) and shareholder letter (Ex.99.2)', but accession 0001104659-26-094568 holds only the 6-K and ex99-1 (EDGAR index checked). The document can be read, but it is marked search_excerpt. Its 582.3 revenue, -190.4 net loss, 236.2 adj EBITDA and 2,246.1 Q2 CFO match.
findings.fix: Retitle it as the press release only. Set retrieval to primary_document if it was read, or cite dc_6k_q2_ofr / dc_6k_q2_fs instead.

findings.finding: The 2026-10-22 Citi financing 6-K is registered twice with different URLs and different independence: dc_6k_citi (ex99-1, independent true) and fd_rel_20261022 (6k.htm, independent false). The issuer's own releases (all dc_6k_* sources) are marked independent true.
findings.where: gather/documents.json sources dc_6k_citi, dc_6k_*; gather/field.json sources fd_rel_20261022
findings.fix: Keep one id for the Citi 6-K. Mark issuer documents independent false for claims about the issuer itself.

findings.finding: dc_f_capex_q2 (5,700M, from the call, rounded) duplicates the reported nm_capex_fy2026q2 (5,657.4M). The two Q2 capex figures together sum to H1 8,130.3, which matches the 6-K. dc_f_atm (12.7M ATM shares) also rests on the unsaved call transcript.
findings.fix: Use 5,657.4 (dc_6k_q2_ofr) and drop or mark dc_f_capex_q2. Check the ATM share count against the ex99d2 equity note.
